violations.why: The ISR can preempt main between its two reads of test_global_var1. Condition3 is 1, so the ISR writes the variable and the two reads can see different values.
The higher-priority compute ISR can preempt RR_Wheel_isr between its write to array[TRIGGER] and its read-back. The read then returns 999 instead of 1.
The compute ISR can overwrite RT_h after RR_Wheel_isr writes it and before the value is used at line 460.
The compute ISR can overwrite RT_h after RR_Wheel_isr writes it and before the value is used at line 466.
The compute ISR can overwrite RT4 between RR_Wheel_isr's write and its read at line 418.
The compute ISR can overwrite RT4 between RR_Wheel_isr's write and its read at line 451.
